LESSON: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Prayers on special occasions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Prayers on special occasions, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to perform swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd? 2. How can a Muslim prepare for swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the conditions of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd for their validity,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Prayers on special occasions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. assess the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd for socio- spiritual development,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Prayers on special occasions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. describe the performance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd for spiritual nourishment,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Prayers on special occasions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. perform swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s rewards,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Prayers on special occasions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd as

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Prayers on special occasions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online or on available reference materials for the conditions of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and make notes

2. brainstorm on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd in groups and make class presentations

3. search and watch or listen to video clips on the performance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and make summary notes

4. prepare a sample khutba for both Jum’a and Idd prayers and role play in class,learners with blindness can be given 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online or on available reference materials for the conditions of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and make notes
2. brainstorm on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd in groups and make class presentations
3. search and watch or listen to video clips on the performance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and make summary notes
4. prepare a sample khutba for both Jum’a and Idd prayers and role play in class,learners with blindness can be given 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Prayers on special occasions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: Sharing learnt knowledge enhanced as learners demonstrate the performance of swalatul Jum’a and

swalatul Idd with consideration of fardh and sunnah acts

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners brainstorm

on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd in groups and make class presentations

• Digital literacy: the skills of creating with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners create a

video clip on the performance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and share on social media

● Self-efficacy: effective communication skill enhanced as learners prepare a sample khutba for both Jum’a and Idd prayers

and role play in class

Values:
• Responsibility enhanced as learners brainstorm on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd in groups and make

class presentations

• Respect enhanced as learners respect each other’s views as they brainstorm on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and

swalatul Idd in groups and make class presentations

● Unity enhanced as learners brainstorm on the significance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd in groups and make class

presentations

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills: self-esteem enhanced as learners create video clips on the performance of swalatul Jum’a and swalatul Idd and

share on social media and creative thinking enhanced as learners prepare a sample khutba for both Jum’a and Idd prayers and

role play in class
